{"action":"proof","message":"  have hmem (x : ℝ) : x ∈ S ↔ x = 8 ∨ x = -14 := by
    rw [h₀ x]
    constructor
    · intro h
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 3 - 11), sq_nonneg (x + 3 + 11)]
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hS : S = {8, -14} := by
    ext x
    simp [hmem]
  rw [hS]
  simp"}
